user.title: Add CANAL+ decoder
user.description: Connect to the local CANAL+ decoder API. Typical API ports: wifiBOX+ DSIW74 = 3030, UltraBOX+/PremiumBOX+ = 8080. You can also configure the HDMI encoder, media player to follow and editable channel presets.

error.unsupported_device: The device responded, but its model is not supported by this CANAL+ integration.
error.invalid_presets: Invalid preset list. Use one unique channel per line in the format: number = name.

init.title: CANAL+ decoder settings
init.description: Edit HDMI encoder credentials, source media player and channel presets. When automatic sync is enabled, a media-player channel name matching a preset automatically tunes the corresponding decoder channel.

error.invalid_presets: Invalid preset list. Use: number = name, one preset per line.
